name: Station
description: In the retrieved Station checkout, packaged builds use electron-updater, poll for updates every 30 minutes, and can quit and install after an update is downloaded; the Windows electron-builder configuration explicitly sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature to false. The effective updater verification behavior remains framework-dependent.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; release metadata and the framework's internal verification implementation were not audited.
